ko.title: 650,000표의 투표용지, 전원일치 판결 1건: 캘리포니아 최고법원, 압수된 투표용지 반환을 보안관에게 명령

segments.src: California's highest court has settled one of the most unusual election disputes in recent state history.
segments.tr: 캘리포니아 최고법원이 최근 주 역사상 가장 이례적인 선거 분쟁 중 하나를 해결했습니다.

segments.src: In a pair of unanimous rulings issued Thursday, the California Supreme Court held that Riverside County Sheriff Chad Bianco unlawfully seized roughly 650,000 ballots from the November 2025 redistricting special election.
segments.tr: 목요일에 발표된 두 건의 전원일치 판결에서 캘리포니아 대법원은 리버사이드 카운티 보안관 채드 비앙코(Chad Bianco)가 2025년 11월 선거구 재조정 특별선거에서 약 650,000표의 투표용지를 불법적으로 압수했다고 판결했습니다.

segments.src: The justices ordered him to return them to county election officials.
segments.tr: 대법관들은 그에게 투표용지를 카운티 선거 관리들에게 반환하라고 명령했습니다.

segments.src: The decision comes about six weeks before the November midterms.
segments.tr: 이번 결정은 11월 중간선거를 약 6주 앞두고 나왔습니다.

segments.src: It answers a question that reaches well beyond one county: **when a criminal investigation touches an election, who is allowed to hold the ballots?**
segments.tr: 이 판결은 단일 카운티를 넘어선 질문에 대한 답을 제시합니다: **형사 수사가 선거에 영향을 미칠 때, 누가 투표용지를 보관할 권한이 있는가?**

segments.src: ## What the Court Decided
segments.tr: ## 법원의 결정 내용

segments.src: The court issued two rulings on the same day, and both went against the sheriff.
segments.tr: 법원은 같은 날 두 건의 판결을 내렸으며, 두 건 모두 보안관에게 불리한 판결이었습니다.

segments.src: - **The seizure was unlawful.** Under California law, voted ballots must stay in the custody and control of election officials. The court found that this rule holds even when law enforcement says it is conducting a criminal investigation. Reports on the opinion say the justices concluded that the seizure created a substantial risk to election integrity.
segments.tr: - **압수는 불법이었습니다.** 캘리포니아 법에 따라, 기표된 투표용지는 선거 관리의 보관 및 통제하에 있어야 합니다. 법원은 사법 기관이 형사 수사를 진행 중이라고 주장하더라도 이 규칙이 유지된다고 판단했습니다. 의견서 관련 보도에 따르면 대법관들은 이번 압수가 선거 무결성에 상당한 위험을 초래했다고 결론지었습니다.

segments.src: - **The attorney general could give the order.** In the companion case, the court held that Attorney General Rob Bonta had the authority to direct the sheriff to hold off on executing a search warrant for the ballots, and that the sheriff was required to comply. Coverage of the ruling attributes the opinion to Chief Justice Patricia Guerrero.
segments.tr: - **검찰총장은 명령을 내릴 권한이 있었습니다.** 관련 사건에서 법원은 롭 본타(Rob Bonta) 검찰총장이 보안관에게 투표용지에 대한 수색영장 집행을 보류하도록 지시할 권한이 있으며, 보안관은 이에 따라야 한다고 판결했습니다. 판결 보도에 따르면 이번 의견서는 패트리샤 게레로(Patricia Guerrero) 대법원장이 작성했습니다.

segments.src: Bianco was ordered to return the ballots to the Riverside County registrar of voters.
segments.tr: 비앙코 보안관은 리버사이드 카운티 유권자 등록 청장에게 투표용지를 반환하라는 명령을 받았습니다.

segments.src: Until then, he is to refrain from handling them except as needed to carry out the order.
segments.tr: 그때까지 그는 명령을 이행하는 데 필요한 경우를 제외하고는 투표용지를 취급하지 않아야 합니다.

segments.src: According to local reporting, the rulings become final after 30 days.
segments.tr: 지역 보도에 따르면 판결은 30일 후에 최종 확정됩니다.

segments.src: ## How the Dispute Unfolded
segments.tr: ## 분쟁의 전개 과정

segments.src: The ballots at the center of the case come from the special election on Proposition 50, the measure to redraw California's congressional districts.
segments.tr: 이번 사건의 중심에 있는 투표용지는 캘리포니아의 연방 하원의원 선거구를 재조정하는 조치인 발의안 50조(Proposition 50) 특별선거에서 나온 것입니다.

segments.src: It passed statewide and also carried Riverside County by roughly 80,000 votes.
segments.tr: 이 발의안은 주 전체에서 통과되었으며 리버사이드 카운티에서도 약 80,000표 차이로 승리했습니다.

segments.src: - **February 2026:** A local citizens group alleged a discrepancy in the vote count. County election officials described the complaint as unfounded.
segments.tr: - **2026년 2월:** 지역 주민 단체가 개표 결과의 불일치를 주장했습니다. 카운티 선거 관리들은 이 민원이 근거가 없다고 설명했습니다.

segments.src: - **Late February 2026:** Bianco's deputies seized the ballots under a search warrant. A recount began under the supervision of a court-appointed special master, and it was suspended within days as legal challenges piled up.
segments.tr: - **2026년 2월 말:** 비앙코 보안관의 부관들이 수색영장에 따라 투표용지를 압수했습니다. 법원이 임명한 특별조사관의 감독하에 재개표가 시작되었으나, 법적 반발이 거세지면서 며칠 만에 중단되었습니다.

segments.src: - **March 2026:** The attorney general directed the sheriff to stand down. Bianco did not initially comply, and the dispute moved into the courts.
segments.tr: - **2026년 3월:** 검찰총장이 보안관에게 철수를 지시했습니다. 비앙코 보안관은 처음에 이에 응하지 않았고, 분쟁은 법원으로 넘어가게 되었습니다.

segments.src: - **April 2026:** The California Supreme Court stepped in and ordered the review of the seized ballots stopped while it considered the case.
segments.tr: - **2026년 4월:** 캘리포니아 대법원이 개입하여 사건을 검토하는 동안 압수한 투표용지에 대한 조사를 중단하도록 명령했습니다.

segments.src: - **August 2026:** The justices heard oral arguments.
segments.tr: - **2026년 8월:** 대법관들이 구두 변론을 청취했습니다.

segments.src: - **September 2026:** The court issued its unanimous rulings.
segments.tr: - **2026년 9월:** 법원이 전원일치 판결을 내렸습니다.

segments.src: ## The Sheriff's Position
segments.tr: ## 보안관 측의 입장

segments.src: Bianco's side argued that the sheriff had a legal duty to investigate a complaint that had been brought to him and that the ballots were evidence.
segments.tr: 비앙코 측은 보안관이 자신에게 제기된 민원을 수사할 법적 의무가 있으며 투표용지는 증거물이라고 주장했습니다.

segments.src: His attorney made that case to the court.
segments.tr: 그의 변호인은 법원에서 이 점을 변론했습니다.

segments.src: Bianco did not immediately comment after the ruling was released.
segments.tr: 비앙코 보안관은 판결이 공개된 후 즉각적인 입장을 밝히지 않았습니다.

segments.src: Bianco also ran in California's June 2026 gubernatorial primary but did not advance to the general election, according to NBC News.
segments.tr: NBC 뉴스에 따르면 비앙코는 2026년 6월 캘리포니아 주지사 예비선거에도 출마했으나 본선에 진출하지 못했습니다.

segments.src: He has said he plans to seek re-election as sheriff in 2028.
segments.tr: 그는 2028년에 보안관 재선에 도전할 계획이라고 밝혔습니다.

segments.src: ## Why Custody Matters
segments.tr: ## 보관 체인이 중요한 이유

segments.src: Election law treats the chain of custody for ballots much like a court treats physical evidence: the fewer hands involved, and the more clearly documented each transfer, the more confidence the public can have in the count.
segments.tr: 선거법은 투표용지의 보관 연속성(chain of custody)을 법원이 물적 증거를 다루는 방식과 매우 유사하게 취급합니다. 관여하는 손길이 적을수록, 그리고 각 이관 과정이 더 명확히 문서화될수록 대중은 개표 결과에 대해 더 큰 신뢰를 가질 수 있습니다.

segments.src: California places that responsibility with county election officials, who work under public observation rules and state oversight.
segments.tr: 캘리포니아주는 이러한 책임을 대중의 참관 규칙과 주의 감독하에 일하는 카운티 선거 관리들에게 부여합니다.

segments.src: The court's reasoning reflects a concern that separate custody rules for law enforcement could undercut that system.
segments.tr: 법원의 논리는 사법 기관에 대한 별도의 보관 규칙이 이러한 시스템을 약화시킬 수 있다는 우려를 반영합니다.

segments.src: If a ballot can leave the registrar's control at any time for an outside investigation, it becomes harder to show that no one altered it.
segments.tr: 투표용지가 외부 수사를 이유로 언제든지 유권자 등록 청장의 통제에서 벗어날 수 있다면, 누구도 이를 조작하지 않았음을 증명하기가 더 어려워집니다.

segments.src: That is a problem whether or not any wrongdoing occurred.
segments.tr: 이는 실제로 불법 행위가 발생했는지 여부와 상관없이 문제가 됩니다.

segments.src: The ruling does not say that election-related crimes cannot be investigated.
segments.tr: 이번 판결이 선거 관련 범죄를 수사할 수 없다는 뜻은 아닙니다.

segments.src: It says that voted ballots stay with election officials while that happens.
segments.tr: 수사가 진행되는 동안에도 기표된 투표용지는 선거 관리들이 보관해야 한다는 의미입니다.

segments.src: ## The Legislative Follow-Up
segments.tr: ## 입법적 후속 조치

segments.src: The ruling arrived days after Gov.
segments.tr: 이 판결은 개빈 놈슴(Gavin Newsom) 주지사가

segments.src: Gavin Newsom signed a package of 13 election bills on September 19.
segments.tr: 9월 19일 13개 선거 법안 패키지에 서명한 지 며칠 만에 나왔습니다.

segments.src: According to reporting on the package, it includes measures that:
segments.tr: 해당 패키지에 대한 보도에 따르면, 다음 내용이 포함되어 있습니다:

segments.src: - make it a felony to seize, or to direct or assist in seizing, ballots, election records or certified voting equipment before results are certified (Assembly Bill 282);
segments.tr: - 결과가 승인되기 전에 투표용지, 선거 기록 또는 승인된 투표 장비를 압수하거나 압수를 지시 또는 지원하는 행위를 중범죄로 규정 (하원 법안 Assembly Bill 282);

segments.src: - make it a felony for a person with supervisory authority to direct someone to interfere with the delivery or return of a vote-by-mail ballot (Senate Bill 259); and
segments.tr: - 감독 권한이 있는 자가 우편 투표용지의 전달 또는 반환을 방해하도록 누군가에게 지시하는 행위를 중범죄로 규정 (상원 법안 Senate Bill 259); 및

segments.src: - require election officials to notify the attorney general and secretary of state right away about any warrant, subpoena or law enforcement investigation involving election records or voting equipment (Assembly Bill 1664).
segments.tr: - 선거 관리들이 선거 기록이나 투표 장비가 관련된 영장, 영장 교부 요구 또는 사법 기관 수사에 대해 즉시 검찰총장과 주무장관에게 통지하도록 의무화 (하원 법안 Assembly Bill 1664).

segments.src: Supporters describe the laws as guardrails for the midterms.
segments.tr: 지지자들은 이 법안들을 중간선거를 위한 안전장치라고 설명합니다.

segments.src: Critics of the measures have questioned whether such restrictions might limit legitimate investigations, a debate likely to continue.
segments.tr: 반면 이 조치들에 대한 비판자들은 이러한 제한이 정당한 수사를 제한할 수 있는지에 대해 의문을 제기하고 있어 논란은 계속될 것으로 보입니다.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 향후 전망

segments.src: Several questions remain open:
segments.tr: 몇 가지 질문이 여전히 남아 있습니다:

segments.src: 1. **The return of the ballots.** Bianco must hand the ballots back to the Riverside County registrar. How that transfer is documented will draw scrutiny.
segments.tr: 1. **투표용지 반환.** 비앙코 보안관은 리버사이드 카운티 유권자 등록 청장에게 투표용지를 돌려주어야 합니다. 이 이관 과정이 어떻게 문서화될지가 철저한 검증을 받게 될 것입니다.

segments.src: 2. **The fate of the investigation.** Coverage differs on what happens to the underlying inquiry. One local report says the attorney general will decide whether it continues, so the details may become clearer in the coming weeks.
segments.tr: 2. **수사의 향방.** 기사의 바탕이 되는 수사가 어떻게 될지에 대해서는 보도마다 차이가 있습니다. 한 지역 보도에 따르면 검찰총장이 수사 계속 여부를 결정할 예정이므로, 향후 몇 주 안에 세부 사항이 더 명확해질 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 3. **The wider fight over election materials.** With the midterms approaching, this case sits inside a larger national argument over who may access, hold and review election records, and under what safeguards.
segments.tr: 3. **선거 자료를 둘러싼 광범위한 논쟁.** 중간선거가 다가옴에 따라 이번 사건은 선거 기록에 누가 접근, 보관 및 검토할 수 있는지, 그리고 어떤 안전장치 하에 이뤄져야 하는지에 대한 더 큰 전국적 논쟁의 틀 안에 놓이게 됩니다.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 핵심 요약

segments.src: The California Supreme Court did not have to decide whether the sheriff's fraud concerns were right.
segments.tr: 캘리포니아 최고법원은 보안관의 부정선거 우려가 타당했는지 여부를 결정할 필요는 없었습니다.

segments.src: It had to decide who is allowed to hold the ballots.
segments.tr: 누가 투표용지를 보관할 권한이 있는지를 결정해야 했습니다.

segments.src: Its answer was unanimous: election officials hold them, even during a criminal investigation, and the attorney general can order a sheriff to stand down.
segments.tr: 법원의 답변은 전원일치였습니다. 형사 수사 중이라도 투표용지는 선거 관리들이 보관하며, 검찰총장은 보안관에게 철수를 명령할 수 있다는 것입니다.

segments.src: For voters, the practical takeaway is that the ballots from that election go back to the officials who are responsible for counting them.
segments.tr: 유권자들에게 실질적인 시사점은 해당 선거의 투표용지가 개표 책임이 있는 관리들에게 다시 돌아간다는 점입니다.

segments.src: *This article summarizes public reporting from major news outlets as of September 25, 2026.
segments.tr: *본 기사는 2026년 9월 25일 기준 주요 언론사의 공개 보도를 요약한 것입니다.

segments.src: Details may change as the case develops.*
segments.tr: 사건의 전개에 따라 세부 사항이 변경될 수 있습니다.*

zh.title: 650,000张选票，一致裁决：加州最高法院下令警长归还扣押的选票

segments.src: California's highest court has settled one of the most unusual election disputes in recent state history.
segments.tr: 加州最高法院解决了该州近代史上最不同寻常的一起选举纠纷。

segments.src: In a pair of unanimous rulings issued Thursday, the California Supreme Court held that Riverside County Sheriff Chad Bianco unlawfully seized roughly 650,000 ballots from the November 2025 redistricting special election.
segments.tr: 在周四发布的两项一致裁决中，加州最高法院裁定，河滨县警长查德·比安科（Chad Bianco）非法扣押了2025年11月选区重划特别选举中约650,000张选票。

segments.src: The justices ordered him to return them to county election officials.
segments.tr: 大法官们下令他将这些选票归还给县选举官员。

segments.src: The decision comes about six weeks before the November midterms.
segments.tr: 这项裁决是在11月中期选举前约六周做出的。

segments.src: It answers a question that reaches well beyond one county: **when a criminal investigation touches an election, who is allowed to hold the ballots?**
segments.tr: 它回答了一个影响远超单一县的问题：**当刑事调查涉及选举时，谁有权保管选票？**

segments.src: ## What the Court Decided
segments.tr: ## 法院的裁决

segments.src: The court issued two rulings on the same day, and both went against the sheriff.
segments.tr: 法院在同一天发布了两项裁决，且都对警长不利。

segments.src: - **The seizure was unlawful.** Under California law, voted ballots must stay in the custody and control of election officials. The court found that this rule holds even when law enforcement says it is conducting a criminal investigation. Reports on the opinion say the justices concluded that the seizure created a substantial risk to election integrity.
segments.tr: - **扣押行为非法。** 根据加州法律，已投票的选票必须保留在选举官员的保管和控制之下。法院认为，即使执法部门声称正在进行刑事调查，这一规则依然适用。关于该意见的报道称，大法官们得出结论，此次扣押对选举的完整性构成了重大风险。

segments.src: - **The attorney general could give the order.** In the companion case, the court held that Attorney General Rob Bonta had the authority to direct the sheriff to hold off on executing a search warrant for the ballots, and that the sheriff was required to comply. Coverage of the ruling attributes the opinion to Chief Justice Patricia Guerrero.
segments.tr: - **总检察长有权下达命令。** 在相关联的案件中，法院裁定总检察长罗伯·邦塔（Rob Bonta）有权指示警长停止执行针对选票的搜查令，且警长必须遵守。对该裁决的报道将此意见归功于首席大法官帕特里夏·格雷罗（Patricia Guerrero）。

segments.src: Bianco was ordered to return the ballots to the Riverside County registrar of voters.
segments.tr: 比安科被勒令将选票归还给河滨县选民登记处。

segments.src: It passed statewide and also carried Riverside County by roughly 80,000 votes.

segments.src: - **February 2026:** A local citizens group alleged a discrepancy in the vote count. County election officials described the complaint as unfounded.

segments.src: ## The Sheriff's Position

segments.src: Bianco's side argued that the sheriff had a legal duty to investigate a complaint that had been brought to him and that the ballots were evidence.

segments.src: ## Why Custody Matters
segments.tr: ## 为什么保管权很重要

segments.src: Election law treats the chain of custody for ballots much like a court treats physical evidence: the fewer hands involved, and the more clearly documented each transfer, the more confidence the public can have in the count.
segments.tr: 选举法对待选票的保管链就像法院对待物证一样：涉及的人手越少，每次移交的记录越清晰，公众对计票结果的信心就越强。

segments.src: That is a problem whether or not any wrongdoing occurred.
segments.tr: 无论是否发生了不当行为，这都是一个问题。

segments.src: The ruling does not say that election-related crimes cannot be investigated.
segments.tr: 该裁决并未表示不能调查与选举有关的犯罪。

segments.src: It says that voted ballots stay with election officials while that happens.

segments.src: Supporters describe the laws as guardrails for the midterms.

segments.src: Critics of the measures have questioned whether such restrictions might limit legitimate investigations, a debate likely to continue.

segments.src: 3. **The wider fight over election materials.** With the midterms approaching, this case sits inside a larger national argument over who may access, hold and review election records, and under what safeguards.

es.title: 650.000 papeletas, un fallo unánime: El tribunal supremo de California ordena a un sheriff devolver los votos incautados

segments.src: California's highest court has settled one of the most unusual election disputes in recent state history.
segments.tr: El tribunal más alto de California ha resuelto una de las disputas electorales más inusuales en la historia reciente del estado.

segments.src: In a pair of unanimous rulings issued Thursday, the California Supreme Court held that Riverside County Sheriff Chad Bianco unlawfully seized roughly 650,000 ballots from the November 2025 redistricting special election.
segments.tr: En un par de fallos unánimes emitidos el jueves, la Corte Suprema de California dictaminó que el sheriff del condado de Riverside, Chad Bianco, incautó ilegalmente aproximadamente 650.000 papeletas de la elección especial de redistribución de distritos de noviembre de 2025.

segments.src: The justices ordered him to return them to county election officials.
segments.tr: Los magistrados le ordenaron devolverlas a los funcionarios electorales del condado.

segments.src: The decision comes about six weeks before the November midterms.
segments.tr: La decisión llega unas seis semanas antes de las elecciones de mitad de período de noviembre.

segments.src: It answers a question that reaches well beyond one county: **when a criminal investigation touches an election, who is allowed to hold the ballots?**
segments.tr: Responde a una pregunta que va mucho más allá de un solo condado: **cuando una investigación penal afecta a una elección, ¿quién está autorizado a custodiar las papeletas?**

segments.src: ## What the Court Decided
segments.tr: ## Lo que decidió el tribunal

segments.src: The court issued two rulings on the same day, and both went against the sheriff.
segments.tr: El tribunal emitió dos fallos el mismo día, y ambos fueron en contra del sheriff.

segments.src: - **The seizure was unlawful.** Under California law, voted ballots must stay in the custody and control of election officials. The court found that this rule holds even when law enforcement says it is conducting a criminal investigation. Reports on the opinion say the justices concluded that the seizure created a substantial risk to election integrity.
segments.tr: - **La incautación fue ilegal.** Según la ley de California, las papeletas votadas deben permanecer bajo la custodia y el control de los funcionarios electorales. El tribunal determinó que esta regla se mantiene incluso cuando las fuerzas del orden afirman estar llevando a cabo una investigación penal. Los informes sobre la opinión señalan que los magistrados concluyeron que la incautación creaba un riesgo sustancial para la integridad electoral.

segments.src: - **The attorney general could give the order.** In the companion case, the court held that Attorney General Rob Bonta had the authority to direct the sheriff to hold off on executing a search warrant for the ballots, and that the sheriff was required to comply. Coverage of the ruling attributes the opinion to Chief Justice Patricia Guerrero.
segments.tr: - **El fiscal general podía dar la orden.** En el caso complementario, el tribunal sostuvo que el fiscal general Rob Bonta tenía la autoridad para ordenar al sheriff que se abstuviera de ejecutar una orden de registro para las papeletas, y que el sheriff estaba obligado a cumplir. La cobertura del fallo atribuye la opinión a la presidenta del tribunal, Patricia Guerrero.

segments.src: Bianco was ordered to return the ballots to the Riverside County registrar of voters.
segments.tr: Se ordenó a Bianco devolver las papeletas al registrador de votantes del condado de Riverside.

segments.src: Until then, he is to refrain from handling them except as needed to carry out the order.
segments.tr: Hasta entonces, debe abstenerse de manipularlas, excepto según sea necesario para cumplir con la orden.

segments.src: According to local reporting, the rulings become final after 30 days.
segments.tr: Según los informes locales, los fallos serán definitivos después de 30 días.

segments.src: It answers a question that reaches well beyond one county: **when a criminal investigation touches an election, who is allowed to hold the ballots?**
segments.tr: إنه يجيب على سؤال يمتد إلى ما هو أبعد بكثير من مقاطعة واحدة: **عندما يمس تحقيق جنائي عملية انتخابية، من يُسمح له بالاحتفاظ بأوراق الاقتراع؟**

segments.src: ## What the Court Decided
segments.tr: ## ما قررته المحكمة

segments.src: The court issued two rulings on the same day, and both went against the sheriff.
segments.tr: أصدرت المحكمة حكمين في نفس اليوم، وجاء كلاهما ضد الشريف.

segments.src: - **The seizure was unlawful.** Under California law, voted ballots must stay in the custody and control of election officials. The court found that this rule holds even when law enforcement says it is conducting a criminal investigation. Reports on the opinion say the justices concluded that the seizure created a substantial risk to election integrity.
segments.tr: - **المصادرة كانت غير قانونية.** بموجب قانون كاليفورنيا، يجب أن تبقى أوراق الاقتراع التي تم التصويت بها في عهدة وسيطرة مسؤولي الانتخابات. ووجدت المحكمة أن هذه القاعدة تسري حتى عندما تقول إنفاذ القانون إنها تجري تحقيقاً جنائياً. وتقول التقارير حول الرأي إن القضاة خلصوا إلى أن المصادرة شكلت خطراً كبيراً على نزاهة الانتخابات.

segments.src: - **The attorney general could give the order.** In the companion case, the court held that Attorney General Rob Bonta had the authority to direct the sheriff to hold off on executing a search warrant for the ballots, and that the sheriff was required to comply. Coverage of the ruling attributes the opinion to Chief Justice Patricia Guerrero.
segments.tr: - **كان بإمكان المدعي العام إصدار الأمر.** في القضية المرافقة، قضى بأن المدعي العام روب بونتا كان يملك الصلاحية لتوجيه الشريف بوقف تنفيذ مذكرة تفتيش لأوراق الاقتراع، وأنه كان مطلوباً من الشريف الامتثال. وتنسب تغطية الحكم الرأي إلى رئيسة المحكمة باتريسيا غيريرو.

segments.src: Bianco was ordered to return the ballots to the Riverside County registrar of voters.
segments.tr: أُمر بيانكو بإعادة أوراق الاقتراع إلى مسجل الناخبين في مقاطعة ريفرسيد.

segments.src: Until then, he is to refrain from handling them except as needed to carry out the order.
segments.tr: وحتى ذلك الحين، عليه الامتناع عن التعامل معها إلا بالقدر اللازم لتنفيذ الأمر.

segments.src: According to local reporting, the rulings become final after 30 days.
segments.tr: وفقاً للتقارير المحلية، تصبح الأحكام نهائية بعد 30 يوماً.

segments.src: ## How the Dispute Unfolded
segments.tr: ## كيف تطور النزاع

segments.src: The ballots at the center of the case come from the special election on Proposition 50, the measure to redraw California's congressional districts.
segments.tr: تأتي أوراق الاقتراع التي تقع في قلب القضية من الانتخابات الخاصة بشأن الاقتراح 50، وهو الإجراء الخاص بإعادة ترسيم دوائر الكونغرس في كاليفورنيا.

segments.src: It passed statewide and also carried Riverside County by roughly 80,000 votes.
segments.tr: لقد مر على مستوى الولاية وحقق فوزاً أيضاً في مقاطعة ريفرسيد بنحو 80,000 صوت.

segments.src: - **February 2026:** A local citizens group alleged a discrepancy in the vote count. County election officials described the complaint as unfounded.
segments.tr: - **فبراير 2026:** ادعت مجموعة مواطنين محلية وجود تناقض في فرز الأصوات. ووصف مسؤولي الانتخابات في المقاطعة الشكوى بأنها لا أساس لها من الصحة.

segments.src: - **Late February 2026:** Bianco's deputies seized the ballots under a search warrant. A recount began under the supervision of a court-appointed special master, and it was suspended within days as legal challenges piled up.
segments.tr: - **أواخر فبراير 2026:** صادر نواب بيانكو أوراق الاقتراع بموجب مذكرة تفتيش. وبدأ إعادة فرز الأصوات تحت إشراف خبير خاص تعيينه المحكمة، وتم تعليقه في غضون أيام مع تزايد الطعون القانونية.

segments.src: - **March 2026:** The attorney general directed the sheriff to stand down. Bianco did not initially comply, and the dispute moved into the courts.
segments.tr: - **مارس 2026:** وجه المدعي العام الشريف بالتنحي جانباً. لم يمتثل بيانكو في البداية، وانتقل النزاع إلى المحاكم.

segments.src: - **April 2026:** The California Supreme Court stepped in and ordered the review of the seized ballots stopped while it considered the case.
segments.tr: - **أبريل 2026:** تدخلت المحكمة العليا في كاليفورنيا وأمرت بوقف مراجعة أوراق الاقتراع المضبوطة بينما نظرت في القضية.

segments.src: - **August 2026:** The justices heard oral arguments.
segments.tr: - **أغسطس 2026:** استمع القضاة إلى المرافعات الشفوية.

segments.src: - **September 2026:** The court issued its unanimous rulings.
segments.tr: - **سبتمبر 2026:** أصدرت المحكمة أحكامها بالإجماع.

segments.src: ## The Sheriff's Position
segments.tr: ## موقف الشريف

segments.src: Bianco's side argued that the sheriff had a legal duty to investigate a complaint that had been brought to him and that the ballots were evidence.
segments.tr: جادل فريق بيانكو بأن الشريف كان عليه واجب قانوني للتحقيق في شكوى قدمت إليه وأن أوراق الاقتراع كانت أدلة.

segments.src: His attorney made that case to the court.
segments.tr: وقد عرض محاميه هذه القضية أمام المحكمة.

segments.src: Bianco did not immediately comment after the ruling was released.
segments.tr: ولم يعلق بيانكو على الفور بعد صدور الحكم.

segments.src: Bianco also ran in California's June 2026 gubernatorial primary but did not advance to the general election, according to NBC News.
segments.tr: كما ترشح بيانكو في انتخابات حاكم كاليفورنيا التمهيدية في يونيو 2026 لكنه لم يتأهل إلى الانتخابات العامة، وفقاً لشبكة إن بي سي نيوز.

segments.src: He has said he plans to seek re-election as sheriff in 2028.
segments.tr: وقد قال إنه يخطط للترشح مجدداً لمنصب الشريف في عام 2028.

segments.src: ## Why Custody Matters
segments.tr: ## لماذا تسود الحراسة

segments.src: Election law treats the chain of custody for ballots much like a court treats physical evidence: the fewer hands involved, and the more clearly documented each transfer, the more confidence the public can have in the count.
segments.tr: يتعامل قانون الانتخابات مع سلسلة الحراسة لأوراق الاقتراع بطريقة تشبه إلى حد كبير تعامل المحكمة مع الأدلة المادية: كلما قل عدد الأيادي المعنية، وكلما تم توثيق كل عملية نقل بوضوح أكبر، كلما زادت ثقة الجمهور في الفرز.

segments.src: California places that responsibility with county election officials, who work under public observation rules and state oversight.
segments.tr: تضع كاليفورنيا هذه المسؤولية على عاتق مسؤولي الانتخابات في المقاطعات، الذين يعملون تحت قواعد المراقبة العامة والرقابة الحكومية.

segments.src: The court's reasoning reflects a concern that separate custody rules for law enforcement could undercut that system.
segments.tr: يعكس استدلال المحكمة قلقاً من أن قواعد الحراسة المنفصلة لإنفاذ القانون يمكن أن تقوض هذا النظام.

segments.src: If a ballot can leave the registrar's control at any time for an outside investigation, it becomes harder to show that no one altered it.
segments.tr: إذا كان بإمكان ورقة الاقتراع مغادرة سيطرة المسجل في أي وقت من أجل تحقيق خارجي، يصبح من الصعب إثبات أن أحداً لم يقم بتغييرها.

segments.src: That is a problem whether or not any wrongdoing occurred.
segments.tr: هذه مشكلة سواء حدث أي خطأ أم لا.

segments.src: The ruling does not say that election-related crimes cannot be investigated.
segments.tr: لا يقول الحكم إنه لا يمكن التحقيق في الجرائم المتعلقة بالانتخابات.

segments.src: It says that voted ballots stay with election officials while that happens.
segments.tr: بل يقول إن أوراق الاقتراع التي تم التصويت عليها تبقى مع مسؤولي الانتخابات أثناء حدوث ذلك.

segments.src: ## The Legislative Follow-Up
segments.tr: ## المتابعة التشريعية

segments.src: The ruling arrived days after Gov.
segments.tr: جاء الحكم بعد أيام من توقيع الحاكم

segments.src: Gavin Newsom signed a package of 13 election bills on September 19.
segments.tr: غافن نيوسوم على حزمة من 13 قانوناً انتخابياً في 19 سبتمبر.

segments.src: According to reporting on the package, it includes measures that:
segments.tr: وفقاً للتقارير الواردة حول الحزمة، فهي تتضمن تدابير:

segments.src: - make it a felony to seize, or to direct or assist in seizing, ballots, election records or certified voting equipment before results are certified (Assembly Bill 282);
segments.tr: - تجعل من الجناية الاستيلاء على، أو توجيه أو المساعدة في الاستيلاء على، أوراق الاقتراع أو سجلات الانتخابات أو معدات التصويت المعتمدة قبل اعتماد النتائج (مشروع قانون الجمعية 282)؛

segments.src: - make it a felony for a person with supervisory authority to direct someone to interfere with the delivery or return of a vote-by-mail ballot (Senate Bill 259); and
segments.tr: - تجعل من الجناية لأي شخص لديه سلطة إشرافية توجيه شخص ما للتدخل في تسليم أو إرجاع ورقة اقتراع عبر البريد (مشروع قانون مجلس الشيوخ 259)؛ و

segments.src: - require election officials to notify the attorney general and secretary of state right away about any warrant, subpoena or law enforcement investigation involving election records or voting equipment (Assembly Bill 1664).
segments.tr: - تطالب مسؤولي الانتخابات بإبلاغ المدعي العام ووزير الخارجية فوراً بأي مذكرة أو استدعاء أو تحقيق لإنفاذ القانون يتعلق بسجلات الانتخابات أو معدات التصويت (مشروع قانون الجمعية 1664).

segments.src: Supporters describe the laws as guardrails for the midterms.
segments.tr: يصف المؤيدون القوانين بأنها حواجز حماية لانتخابات التجديد النصفي.

segments.src: Critics of the measures have questioned whether such restrictions might limit legitimate investigations, a debate likely to continue.
segments.tr: وقد شكك منتقدو التدابير فيما إذا كانت مثل هذه القيود قد تحد من التحقيقات المشروعة، وهو نقاش من المرجح أن يستمر.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## ماذا يأتي بعد ذلك

segments.src: Several questions remain open:
segments.tr: لا تزال عدة أسئلة مفتوحة:

segments.src: 1. **The return of the ballots.** Bianco must hand the ballots back to the Riverside County registrar. How that transfer is documented will draw scrutiny.
segments.tr: 1. **إعادة أوراق الاقتراع.** يجب على بيانكو تسليم أوراق الاقتراع مرة أخرى إلى مسجل مقاطعة ريفرسيد. كيف يتم توثيق هذا النقل سيجذب التدقيق.

segments.src: 2. **The fate of the investigation.** Coverage differs on what happens to the underlying inquiry. One local report says the attorney general will decide whether it continues, so the details may become clearer in the coming weeks.
segments.tr: 2. **مصير التحقيق.** تختلف التغطية حول ما يحدث للتحقيق الأساسي. ويقول تقرير محلي واحد إن المدعي العام سيقرر ما إذا كان سيستمر، لذلك قد تصبح التفاصيل أكثر وضوحاً في الأسابيع المقبلة.

segments.src: 3. **The wider fight over election materials.** With the midterms approaching, this case sits inside a larger national argument over who may access, hold and review election records, and under what safeguards.
segments.tr: 3. **المعركة الأوسع حول المواد الانتخابية.** مع اقتراب انتخابات التجديد النصفي، تقع هذه القضية داخل نقاش وطني أكبر حول من يمكنه الوصول إلى سجلات الانتخابات والاحتفاظ بها ومراجعتها، وتحت أي ضمانات.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.src: The California Supreme Court did not have to decide whether the sheriff's fraud concerns were right.
segments.tr: لم تكن محكمة كاليفورنيا العليا مضطرة للبت فيما إذا كانت مخاوف الشريف بشأن التزوير صحيحة أم لا.

segments.src: It had to decide who is allowed to hold the ballots.
segments.tr: كان عليها أن تقرر من يسمح له بالاحتفاظ بأوراق الاقتراع.

segments.src: Its answer was unanimous: election officials hold them, even during a criminal investigation, and the attorney general can order a sheriff to stand down.
segments.tr: كان ردها بالإجماع: مسؤولو الانتخابات هم من يحتفظون بها، حتى أثناء التحقيق الجنائي، ويمكن للمدعي العام أن يأمر الشريف بالتنحي جانباً.

segments.src: For voters, the practical takeaway is that the ballots from that election go back to the officials who are responsible for counting them.
segments.tr: بالنسبة للناخبين، فإن الخلاصة العملية هي أن أوراق الاقتراع من تلك الانتخابات تعود إلى المسؤولين المسؤولين عن فرزها.

fr.title: 650 000 bulletins de vote, une décision unanime : la plus haute cour de Californie ordonne à un shérif de restituer les votes saisis

segments.src: California's highest court has settled one of the most unusual election disputes in recent state history.
segments.tr: La plus haute cour de Californie a tranché l'un des litiges électoraux les plus inhabituels de l'histoire récente de l'État.

segments.src: In a pair of unanimous rulings issued Thursday, the California Supreme Court held that Riverside County Sheriff Chad Bianco unlawfully seized roughly 650,000 ballots from the November 2025 redistricting special election.
segments.tr: Dans deux décisions unanimes rendues jeudi, la Cour suprême de Californie a statué que le shérif du comté de Riverside, Chad Bianco, avait illégalement saisi environ 650 000 bulletins de vote lors de l'élection spéciale de novembre 2025 sur le redécoupage électoral.

segments.src: The justices ordered him to return them to county election officials.
segments.tr: Les juges lui ont ordonné de les restituer aux responsables électoraux du comté.

segments.src: The decision comes about six weeks before the November midterms.
segments.tr: Cette décision intervient environ six semaines avant les élections de mi-mandat de novembre.

segments.src: It answers a question that reaches well beyond one county: **when a criminal investigation touches an election, who is allowed to hold the ballots?**
segments.tr: Elle répond à une question qui dépasse largement le cadre d'un seul comté : **lorsqu'une enquête criminelle touche à une élection, qui est autorisé à détenir les bulletins de vote ?**

segments.src: ## What the Court Decided
segments.tr: ## Ce que la Cour a décidé

segments.src: The court issued two rulings on the same day, and both went against the sheriff.
segments.tr: La cour a rendu deux décisions le même jour, et toutes deux étaient défavorables au shérif.

segments.src: - **The seizure was unlawful.** Under California law, voted ballots must stay in the custody and control of election officials. The court found that this rule holds even when law enforcement says it is conducting a criminal investigation. Reports on the opinion say the justices concluded that the seizure created a substantial risk to election integrity.
segments.tr: - **La saisie était illégale.** Selon la loi californienne, les bulletins de vote doivent rester sous la garde et le contrôle des responsables électoraux. La cour a estimé que cette règle s'applique même lorsque les forces de l'ordre affirment mener une enquête criminelle. Les rapports sur l'avis indiquent que les juges ont conclu que la saisie créait un risque substantiel pour l'intégrité de l'élection.

segments.src: - **The attorney general could give the order.** In the companion case, the court held that Attorney General Rob Bonta had the authority to direct the sheriff to hold off on executing a search warrant for the ballots, and that the sheriff was required to comply. Coverage of the ruling attributes the opinion to Chief Justice Patricia Guerrero.
segments.tr: - **Le procureur général pouvait donner l'ordre.** Dans l'affaire connexe, la cour a statué que le procureur général Rob Bonta avait l'autorité d'ordonner au shérif de surseoir à l'exécution d'un mandat de perquisition concernant les bulletins de vote, et que le shérif était tenu de s'y conformer. La couverture de la décision attribue l'avis à la présidente de la Cour, Patricia Guerrero.

segments.src: Bianco was ordered to return the ballots to the Riverside County registrar of voters.
segments.tr: Il a été ordonné à Bianco de restituer les bulletins de vote au registraire des électeurs du comté de Riverside.

segments.src: Until then, he is to refrain from handling them except as needed to carry out the order.
segments.tr: D'ici là, il doit s'abstenir de les manipuler, sauf si cela est nécessaire pour exécuter l'ordre.

segments.tr: Selon les rapports locaux, les décisions deviennent définitives après 30 jours.

pt.title: 650.000 Votos, Uma Decisão Unânime: A Suprema Corte da Califórnia Ordena que Xerife Devolva Votos Apreendidos

segments.src: California's highest court has settled one of the most unusual election disputes in recent state history.
segments.tr: A mais alta corte da Califórnia resolveu uma das disputas eleitorais mais incomuns da história recente do estado.

segments.src: In a pair of unanimous rulings issued Thursday, the California Supreme Court held that Riverside County Sheriff Chad Bianco unlawfully seized roughly 650,000 ballots from the November 2025 redistricting special election.
segments.tr: Em duas decisões unânimes emitidas na quinta-feira, a Suprema Corte da Califórnia determinou que o xerife do condado de Riverside, Chad Bianco, apreendeu ilegalmente cerca de 650.000 votos da eleição especial de redistritualização de novembro de 2025.

segments.src: The justices ordered him to return them to county election officials.
segments.tr: Os magistrados ordenaram que ele os devolvesse aos oficiais eleitorais do condado.

segments.src: The decision comes about six weeks before the November midterms.
segments.tr: A decisão chega cerca de seis semanas antes das eleições de meio de mandato de novembro.

segments.src: It answers a question that reaches well beyond one county: **when a criminal investigation touches an election, who is allowed to hold the ballots?**
segments.tr: Ela responde a uma pergunta que vai muito além de um único condado: **quando uma investigação criminal atinge uma eleição, quem tem permissão para reter as cédulas?**

segments.src: ## What the Court Decided
segments.tr: ## O que a Corte Decidiu

segments.src: The court issued two rulings on the same day, and both went against the sheriff.
segments.tr: O tribunal emitiu duas decisões no mesmo dia, e ambas foram contrárias ao xerife.

segments.src: - **The seizure was unlawful.** Under California law, voted ballots must stay in the custody and control of election officials. The court found that this rule holds even when law enforcement says it is conducting a criminal investigation. Reports on the opinion say the justices concluded that the seizure created a substantial risk to election integrity.
segments.tr: - **A apreensão foi ilegal.** Sob a lei da Califórnia, os votos depositados devem permanecer sob a custódia e o controle dos oficiais eleitorais. O tribunal concluiu que esta regra se aplica mesmo quando a aplicação da lei diz estar conduzindo uma investigação criminal. Relatórios sobre a opinião dizem que os magistrados concluíram que a apreensão criou um risco substancial para a integridade eleitoral.

segments.src: - **The attorney general could give the order.** In the companion case, the court held that Attorney General Rob Bonta had the authority to direct the sheriff to hold off on executing a search warrant for the ballots, and that the sheriff was required to comply. Coverage of the ruling attributes the opinion to Chief Justice Patricia Guerrero.
segments.tr: - **O procurador-geral podia dar a ordem.** No caso associado, o tribunal decidiu que o procurador-geral Rob Bonta tinha autoridade para ordenar que o xerife suspendesse a execução de um mandado de busca para as cédulas, e que o xerife era obrigado a cumprir. A cobertura da decisão atribui o parecer à juíza principal Patricia Guerrero.

segments.src: Bianco was ordered to return the ballots to the Riverside County registrar of voters.
segments.tr: Bianco foi ordenado a devolver as cédulas ao registrador de eleitores do condado de Riverside.

segments.src: Until then, he is to refrain from handling them except as needed to carry out the order.
segments.tr: Até lá, ele deve abster-se de manipulá-las, exceto conforme necessário para cumprir a ordem.

segments.src: According to local reporting, the rulings become final after 30 days.
segments.tr: De acordo com reportagens locais, as decisões tornam-se definitivas após 30 dias.

segments.src: ## How the Dispute Unfolded
segments.tr: ## Como a Disputa se Desenvolveu

segments.src: The ballots at the center of the case come from the special election on Proposition 50, the measure to redraw California's congressional districts.
segments.tr: As cédulas no centro do caso vêm da eleição especial sobre a Proposta 50, a medida para redesenhar os distritos congressionais da Califórnia.

segments.src: It passed statewide and also carried Riverside County by roughly 80,000 votes.
segments.tr: Ela foi aprovada em todo o estado e também venceu no condado de Riverside por cerca de 80.000 votos.

segments.src: - **February 2026:** A local citizens group alleged a discrepancy in the vote count. County election officials described the complaint as unfounded.
segments.tr: - **Fevereiro de 2026:** Um grupo de cidadãos locais alegou uma discrepância na contagem de votos. Os oficiais eleitorais do condado descreveram a denúncia como infundada.

segments.src: - **Late February 2026:** Bianco's deputies seized the ballots under a search warrant. A recount began under the supervision of a court-appointed special master, and it was suspended within days as legal challenges piled up.
segments.tr: - **Fim de fevereiro de 2026:** Os subordinados de Bianco apreenderam as cédulas sob um mandado de busca. Uma nova contagem começou sob a supervisão de um mestre especial nomeado pelo tribunal, e foi suspensa em poucos dias à medida que os recursos legais se acumulavam.

segments.src: - **March 2026:** The attorney general directed the sheriff to stand down. Bianco did not initially comply, and the dispute moved into the courts.
segments.tr: - **Março de 2026:** O procurador-geral ordenou que o xerife recuasse. Bianco inicialmente não cumpriu, e a disputa foi levada aos tribunais.

segments.src: - **April 2026:** The California Supreme Court stepped in and ordered the review of the seized ballots stopped while it considered the case.
segments.tr: - **Abril de 2026:** A Suprema Corte da Califórnia interveio e ordenou a suspensão da revisão das cédulas apreendidas enquanto analisava o caso.

segments.src: - **August 2026:** The justices heard oral arguments.
segments.tr: - **Agosto de 2026:** Os magistrados ouviram as argumentações orais.

segments.src: - **September 2026:** The court issued its unanimous rulings.
segments.tr: - **Setembro de 2026:** O tribunal emitiu suas decisões unânimes.

segments.src: ## The Sheriff's Position
segments.tr: ## A Posição do Xerife

segments.src: Bianco's side argued that the sheriff had a legal duty to investigate a complaint that had been brought to him and that the ballots were evidence.
segments.tr: O lado de Bianco argumentou que o xerife tinha o dever legal de investigar uma denúncia que lhe fora trazida e que as cédulas eram evidências.

segments.src: His attorney made that case to the court.
segments.tr: Seu advogado apresentou esse argumento ao tribunal.

segments.src: Bianco did not immediately comment after the ruling was released.
segments.tr: Bianco não comentou imediatamente após a divulgação da decisão.

segments.src: Bianco also ran in California's June 2026 gubernatorial primary but did not advance to the general election, according to NBC News.
segments.tr: Bianco também concorreu nas primárias para governador da Califórnia em junho de 2026, mas não avançou para a eleição geral, de acordo com a NBC News.

segments.src: He has said he plans to seek re-election as sheriff in 2028.
segments.tr: Ele disse que planeja buscar a reeleição como xerife em 2028.

segments.src: ## Why Custody Matters
segments.tr: ## Por Que a Custódia Importa

segments.src: Election law treats the chain of custody for ballots much like a court treats physical evidence: the fewer hands involved, and the more clearly documented each transfer, the more confidence the public can have in the count.
segments.tr: A lei eleitoral trata a cadeia de custódia das cédulas de maneira muito semelhante a como um tribunal trata evidências físicas: quanto menos mãos envolvidas, e quanto mais claramente documentada cada transferência, mais confiança o público pode ter na contagem.

segments.src: California places that responsibility with county election officials, who work under public observation rules and state oversight.
segments.tr: A Califórnia atribui essa responsabilidade aos oficiais eleitorais do condado, que trabalham sob regras de observação pública e supervisão estadual.

segments.src: The court's reasoning reflects a concern that separate custody rules for law enforcement could undercut that system.
segments.tr: O raciocínio do tribunal reflete a preocupação de que regras de custódia separadas para a aplicação da lei possam enfraquecer esse sistema.

segments.src: If a ballot can leave the registrar's control at any time for an outside investigation, it becomes harder to show that no one altered it.
segments.tr: Se uma cédula pode deixar o controle do registrador a qualquer momento para uma investigação externa, torna-se mais difícil provar que ninguém a alterou.

segments.src: That is a problem whether or not any wrongdoing occurred.
segments.tr: Esse é um problema, independentemente de ter ocorrido ou não alguma irregularidade.

segments.src: The ruling does not say that election-related crimes cannot be investigated.
segments.tr: A decisão não diz que crimes relacionados a eleições não podem ser investigados.

segments.src: It says that voted ballots stay with election officials while that happens.
segments.tr: Ela diz que as cédulas votadas permanecem com os oficiais eleitorais enquanto isso acontece.

segments.tr: ## Mengapa Hak Asuh Penting

segments.src: Election law treats the chain of custody for ballots much like a court treats physical evidence: the fewer hands involved, and the more clearly documented each transfer, the more confidence the public can have in the count.
segments.tr: Hukum pemilu memperlakukan rantai pengawasan surat suara hampir sama seperti pengadilan memperlakukan bukti fisik: semakin sedikit pihak yang terlibat, dan semakin jelas setiap transfer didokumentasikan, semakin besar kepercayaan publik terhadap penghitungan tersebut.

segments.src: California places that responsibility with county election officials, who work under public observation rules and state oversight.
segments.tr: California menempatkan tanggung jawab itu pada pejabat pemilu daerah, yang bekerja di bawah aturan pengamatan publik dan pengawasan negara bagian.

segments.src: The court's reasoning reflects a concern that separate custody rules for law enforcement could undercut that system.
segments.tr: Penalaran pengadilan mencerminkan kekhawatiran bahwa aturan pengawasan terpisah untuk penegak hukum dapat merusak sistem tersebut.

segments.src: If a ballot can leave the registrar's control at any time for an outside investigation, it becomes harder to show that no one altered it.
segments.tr: Jika surat suara dapat meninggalkan kendali panitera kapan saja untuk penyelidikan luar, menjadi lebih sulit untuk menunjukkan bahwa tidak ada yang mengubahnya.

segments.src: That is a problem whether or not any wrongdoing occurred.
segments.tr: Itu adalah masalah terlepas dari apakah terjadi kesalahan atau tidak.

segments.src: The ruling does not say that election-related crimes cannot be investigated.
segments.tr: Putusan tersebut tidak mengatakan bahwa kejahatan terkait pemilu tidak dapat diselidiki.

segments.src: It says that voted ballots stay with election officials while that happens.
segments.tr: Putusan tersebut mengatakan bahwa surat suara yang telah dicoblos tetap bersama pejabat pemilu saat hal itu terjadi.

segments.src: ## The Legislative Follow-Up
segments.tr: ## Tindak Lanjut Legislatif

segments.src: The ruling arrived days after Gov.
segments.tr: Putusan tersebut tiba beberapa hari setelah Gubernur

segments.src: Gavin Newsom signed a package of 13 election bills on September 19.
segments.tr: Gavin Newsom menandatangani paket 13 undang-undang pemilu pada 19 September.

segments.src: According to reporting on the package, it includes measures that:
segments.tr: Menurut laporan mengenai paket tersebut, itu mencakup langkah-langkah yang:

segments.src: - make it a felony to seize, or to direct or assist in seizing, ballots, election records or certified voting equipment before results are certified (Assembly Bill 282);
segments.tr: - menjadikannya kejahatan berat untuk menyita, atau mengarahkan atau membantu dalam penyitaan, surat suara, catatan pemilu, atau peralatan pemungutan suara bersertifikat sebelum hasil disertifikasi (Assembly Bill 282);

segments.src: - make it a felony for a person with supervisory authority to direct someone to interfere with the delivery or return of a vote-by-mail ballot (Senate Bill 259); and
segments.tr: - menjadikannya kejahatan berat bagi seseorang dengan otoritas pengawasan untuk mengarahkan seseorang untuk mengganggu pengiriman atau pengembalian surat suara melalui pos (Senate Bill 259); dan

segments.src: - require election officials to notify the attorney general and secretary of state right away about any warrant, subpoena or law enforcement investigation involving election records or voting equipment (Assembly Bill 1664).
segments.tr: - mengharuskan pejabat pemilu untuk segera memberi tahu jaksa agung dan sekretaris negara bagian tentang surat perintah, panggilan pengadilan, atau penyelidikan penegak hukum yang melibatkan catatan pemilu atau peralatan pemungutan suara (Assembly Bill 1664).

segments.src: Supporters describe the laws as guardrails for the midterms.
segments.tr: Para pendukung menggambarkan undang-undang tersebut sebagai pagar pembatas untuk pemilihan paruh waktu.

segments.src: Critics of the measures have questioned whether such restrictions might limit legitimate investigations, a debate likely to continue.
segments.tr: Kritikus terhadap langkah-langkah tersebut mempertanyakan apakah pembatasan semacam itu dapat membatasi penyelidikan yang sah, sebuah perdebatan yang kemungkinan akan berlanjut.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Apa Selanjutnya

segments.src: Several questions remain open:
segments.tr: Beberapa pertanyaan masih terbuka:

segments.src: 1. **The return of the ballots.** Bianco must hand the ballots back to the Riverside County registrar. How that transfer is documented will draw scrutiny.
segments.tr: 1. **Pengembalian surat suara.** Bianco harus menyerahkan kembali surat suara kepada panitera Riverside County. Bagaimana transfer itu didokumentasikan akan menarik perhatian.

segments.src: 2. **The fate of the investigation.** Coverage differs on what happens to the underlying inquiry. One local report says the attorney general will decide whether it continues, so the details may become clearer in the coming weeks.
segments.tr: 2. **Nasib penyelidikan.** Liputan berbeda mengenai apa yang terjadi pada penyelidikan yang mendasarinya. Satu laporan lokal mengatakan jaksa agung akan memutuskan apakah itu berlanjut, jadi detailnya mungkin menjadi lebih jelas dalam beberapa minggu mendatang.

segments.src: 3. **The wider fight over election materials.** With the midterms approaching, this case sits inside a larger national argument over who may access, hold and review election records, and under what safeguards.
segments.tr: 3. **Pertarungan yang lebih luas mengenai materi pemilu.** Dengan mendekatnya pemilihan paruh waktu, kasus ini berada di dalam argumen nasional yang lebih besar tentang siapa yang boleh mengakses, memegang, dan meninjau catatan pemilu, dan di bawah perlindungan apa.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Kesimpulan

segments.src: The California Supreme Court did not have to decide whether the sheriff's fraud concerns were right.
segments.tr: Mahkamah Agung California tidak perlu memutuskan apakah kekhawatiran penipuan sheriff itu benar.

segments.src: It had to decide who is allowed to hold the ballots.
segments.tr: Mereka harus memutuskan siapa yang diizinkan untuk memegang surat suara.

segments.src: Its answer was unanimous: election officials hold them, even during a criminal investigation, and the attorney general can order a sheriff to stand down.
segments.tr: Jawabannya bulat: pejabat pemilu yang memegangnya, bahkan selama penyelidikan kriminal, dan jaksa agung dapat memerintahkan sheriff untuk mundur.

segments.src: For voters, the practical takeaway is that the ballots from that election go back to the officials who are responsible for counting them.
segments.tr: Bagi pemilih, kesimpulan praktisnya adalah bahwa surat suara dari pemilihan tersebut kembali kepada pejabat yang bertanggung jawab untuk menghitungnya.

ja.title: 65万票、全会一致の裁定：カリフォルニア州最高裁、保安官に押収された投票用紙の返還を命令

segments.src: California's highest court has settled one of the most unusual election disputes in recent state history.
segments.tr: カリフォルニア州最高裁は、近年の州の歴史において最も異例の選挙紛争の一つに決着をつました。

segments.src: In a pair of unanimous rulings issued Thursday, the California Supreme Court held that Riverside County Sheriff Chad Bianco unlawfully seized roughly 650,000 ballots from the November 2025 redistricting special election.
segments.tr: 木曜日に下された一連の全会一致の裁定で、カリフォルニア州最高裁判所は、リバーサイド郡のチャド・ビアンコ保安官が2025年11月の選挙区画定特別選挙で約65万票の投票用紙を違法に押収したと認定しました。

segments.src: The justices ordered him to return them to county election officials.
segments.tr: 判事らは同氏に対し、それらを郡の選挙管理官に返還するよう命じました。

segments.src: The decision comes about six weeks before the November midterms.
segments.tr: この決定は、11月の中間選挙の約6週間前に行われました。

segments.src: It answers a question that reaches well beyond one county: **when a criminal investigation touches an election, who is allowed to hold the ballots?**
segments.tr: これは一つの郡をはるかに超える問題に答えています：**刑事捜査が選挙に触れたとき、誰が投票用紙を保持することが許されるのか？**

segments.src: ## What the Court Decided
segments.tr: ## 裁判所の決定内容

segments.src: The court issued two rulings on the same day, and both went against the sheriff.
segments.tr: 裁判所は同日に2つの裁定を下し、どちらも保安官に不利なものでした。

segments.src: - **The seizure was unlawful.** Under California law, voted ballots must stay in the custody and control of election officials. The court found that this rule holds even when law enforcement says it is conducting a criminal investigation. Reports on the opinion say the justices concluded that the seizure created a substantial risk to election integrity.
segments.tr: - **押収は違法でした。** カリフォルニア州法に基づき、投票済みの投票用紙は選挙管理官の管理下に置かれなければなりません。裁判所は、法執行機関が刑事捜査を行っていると主張している場合でも、この規則が適用されると判断しました。意見書に関する報道によると、判事らはこの押収により選挙の完全性に対する重大なリスクが生じたと結論づけました。

segments.src: - **The attorney general could give the order.** In the companion case, the court held that Attorney General Rob Bonta had the authority to direct the sheriff to hold off on executing a search warrant for the ballots, and that the sheriff was required to comply. Coverage of the ruling attributes the opinion to Chief Justice Patricia Guerrero.
segments.tr: - **司法長官は命令を出すことができました。** 関連訴訟において、裁判所はロブ・ボンタ司法長官が保安官に対して投票用紙の捜索令状の執行を保留するよう指示する権限を持ち、保安官にはそれに従う義務があると判別しました。この裁定についての報道では、意見書はパトリシア・ゲレーロ最高裁判所長官によるものとされています。

segments.src: Bianco was ordered to return the ballots to the Riverside County registrar of voters.
segments.tr: ビアンコは、投票用紙をリバーサイド郡の有権者登録官に返還するよう命じられました。

segments.src: Until then, he is to refrain from handling them except as needed to carry out the order.
segments.tr: それまで、彼は命令を遂行するために必要な場合を除き、それらを取り扱うことを控えることとされています。

segments.src: According to local reporting, the rulings become final after 30 days.
segments.tr: 地元の報道によると、裁定は30日後に確定します。

segments.src: ## How the Dispute Unfolded
segments.tr: ## 紛争の経緯

segments.src: The ballots at the center of the case come from the special election on Proposition 50, the measure to redraw California's congressional districts.
segments.tr: 事件の中心にある投票用紙は、カリフォルニア州の連邦下院選挙区を再区画する法案である提案第50号の特別選挙からのものです。

segments.src: It passed statewide and also carried Riverside County by roughly 80,000 votes.
segments.tr: それは州全体で可決され、リバーサイド郡でも約8万票差で承認されました。

segments.src: - **February 2026:** A local citizens group alleged a discrepancy in the vote count. County election officials described the complaint as unfounded.
segments.tr: - **2026年2月：** 地元の市民グループが投票数に食い違いがあると主張しました。郡の選挙管理当局はこの苦情を根拠のないものと表現しました。

segments.src: - **Late February 2026:** Bianco's deputies seized the ballots under a search warrant. A recount began under the supervision of a court-appointed special master, and it was suspended within days as legal challenges piled up.
segments.tr: - **2026年2月下旬：** ビアンコの部下たちが捜索令状に基づき投票用紙を押収しました。裁判所が任命した特別管理人の監督下で再集計が開始されましたが、法的挑戦が山積する中で数日以内に中断されました。

segments.src: - **March 2026:** The attorney general directed the sheriff to stand down. Bianco did not initially comply, and the dispute moved into the courts.
segments.tr: - **2026年3月：** 司法長官は保安官に手を引くよう指示しました。ビアンコは当初これに従わず、紛争は法廷に持ち込まれました。

segments.src: - **April 2026:** The California Supreme Court stepped in and ordered the review of the seized ballots stopped while it considered the case.
segments.tr: - **2026年4月：** カリフォルニア州最高裁が介入し、事件を審理している間、押収された投票用紙の審査を停止するよう命じました。

segments.src: - **August 2026:** The justices heard oral arguments.
segments.tr: - **2026年8月：** 判事らは口頭弁論を聞きました。

segments.src: - **September 2026:** The court issued its unanimous rulings.
segments.tr: - **2026年9月：** 裁判所は全会一致の裁定を下しました。

segments.src: ## The Sheriff's Position
segments.tr: ## 保安官の立場

segments.src: Bianco's side argued that the sheriff had a legal duty to investigate a complaint that had been brought to him and that the ballots were evidence.
segments.tr: ビアンコ側は、保安官には持ち込まれた苦情を捜査する法的な義務があり、投票用紙は証拠であると主張しました。

segments.src: His attorney made that case to the court.
segments.tr: 彼の弁護士はその主張を裁判所に伝えました。

segments.src: Bianco did not immediately comment after the ruling was released.
segments.tr: 裁定が発表された後、ビアンコはすぐにコメントしませんでした。

segments.src: Bianco also ran in California's June 2026 gubernatorial primary but did not advance to the general election, according to NBC News.
segments.tr: NBCニュースによると、ビアンコは2026年6月のカリフォルニア州知事予備選挙にも出馬しましたが、本選挙には進みませんでした。

segments.src: He has said he plans to seek re-election as sheriff in 2028.
segments.tr: 彼は2028年に再び保安官に立候補する予定であると述べています。

segments.src: ## Why Custody Matters
segments.tr: ## 管理が重要な理由

segments.src: Election law treats the chain of custody for ballots much like a court treats physical evidence: the fewer hands involved, and the more clearly documented each transfer, the more confidence the public can have in the count.
segments.tr: 選挙法は、投票用紙の管理の連鎖を、裁判所が物的証拠を扱うのとほぼ同じように扱います。関与する人の数が少なく、各移転がより明確に文書化されているほど、一般の人々は集計に対してより多くの信頼を持つことができます。

segments.src: California places that responsibility with county election officials, who work under public observation rules and state oversight.
segments.tr: カリフォルニア州はその責任を郡の選挙管理官に負わせ、彼らは一般公開のルールと州の監督の下で作業を行います。

segments.src: The court's reasoning reflects a concern that separate custody rules for law enforcement could undercut that system.
segments.tr: 裁判所の推論は、法執行機関に対する別の管理規則がそのシステムを損なう可能性があるという懸念を反映しています。

segments.src: If a ballot can leave the registrar's control at any time for an outside investigation, it becomes harder to show that no one altered it.
segments.tr: 外部の捜査のために投票用紙がいつでも登録官の管理から離れることができる場合、誰もそれを改ざんしていないことを示すことが難しくなります。

segments.src: That is a problem whether or not any wrongdoing occurred.
segments.tr: それは不正行為が発生したかどうかにかかわらず問題です。

segments.src: The ruling does not say that election-related crimes cannot be investigated.
segments.tr: この裁定は、選挙関連の犯罪を捜査できないとは述べていません。

segments.src: It says that voted ballots stay with election officials while that happens.
segments.tr: その間、投票済みの投票用紙は選挙管理官のもとに留まると述べています。

segments.src: ## The Legislative Follow-Up
segments.tr: ## 立法上のフォローアップ

segments.src: The ruling arrived days after Gov.
segments.tr: この裁定は、ギャビン・ニューサム知事が9月19日に13の選挙法案パッケージに署名した数日後に下されました。

segments.src: Gavin Newsom signed a package of 13 election bills on September 19.
segments.tr: このパッケージに関する報道によると、次のような措置が含まれています：

segments.src: According to reporting on the package, it includes measures that:
segments.tr: パッケージに関する報道によると、次のような措置が含まれています：

segments.src: - make it a felony to seize, or to direct or assist in seizing, ballots, election records or certified voting equipment before results are certified (Assembly Bill 282);
segments.tr: - 結果が認定される前に、投票用紙、選挙記録、または認定された投票機器を押収すること、または押収を指示もしくは支援することを重罪にする（州議会法案第282号）；

segments.src: - make it a felony for a person with supervisory authority to direct someone to interfere with the delivery or return of a vote-by-mail ballot (Senate Bill 259); and
segments.tr: - 監督権限を持つ人物が、誰かに対して郵送投票用紙の配達や返還を妨害するよう指示することを重罪にする（上院法案第259号）；および

segments.src: - require election officials to notify the attorney general and secretary of state right away about any warrant, subpoena or law enforcement investigation involving election records or voting equipment (Assembly Bill 1664).
segments.tr: - 選挙管理官に対し、選挙記録や投票機器に関連する令状、召喚状、または法執行機関の捜査について、直ちに司法長官と州務長官に通知することを義務付ける（州議会法案第1664号）。

segments.src: Supporters describe the laws as guardrails for the midterms.
segments.tr: 支持者たちは、これらの法律を中間選挙のガードレールであると表現しています。

segments.src: Critics of the measures have questioned whether such restrictions might limit legitimate investigations, a debate likely to continue.
segments.tr: これらの措置の批判者たちは、このような制限が正当な捜査を制限する可能性があるかどうか疑問視しており、この議論は今後も続く見込みです。

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 次に何が起きるか

segments.src: Several questions remain open:
segments.tr: いくつかの疑問が残されています：

segments.src: 1. **The return of the ballots.** Bianco must hand the ballots back to the Riverside County registrar. How that transfer is documented will draw scrutiny.
segments.tr: 1. **投票用紙の返還。** ビアンコは投票用紙をリバーサイド郡の登録官に返還しなければなりません。その移転がどのように文書化されるかが注目を集めるでしょう。

segments.src: 2. **The fate of the investigation.** Coverage differs on what happens to the underlying inquiry. One local report says the attorney general will decide whether it continues, so the details may become clearer in the coming weeks.
segments.tr: 2. **捜査の行方。** 根底にある調査に何が起こるかについては報道が分かれています。地元の報道によると、司法長官がそれが継続するかどうかを決定するため、詳細な情報は今後数週間のうちに明確になる可能性があります。

segments.src: 3. **The wider fight over election materials.** With the midterms approaching, this case sits inside a larger national argument over who may access, hold and review election records, and under what safeguards.
segments.tr: 3. **選挙資材をめぐるより広い戦い。** 中間選挙が近づく中、この事件は、誰が選挙記録にアクセスし、保持し、審査することが許可されるか、そしてどのような保護措置の下で行われるかという、より大きな全国的な議論の中に位置づけられています。

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 結論

segments.src: The California Supreme Court did not have to decide whether the sheriff's fraud concerns were right.
segments.tr: カリフォルニア州最高裁判所は、保安官の不正行為に関する懸念が正しいかどうかを判断する必要はありませんでした。

segments.src: It had to decide who is allowed to hold the ballots.
segments.tr: 誰が投票用紙を保持することが許されているかを判断しなければなりませんでした。

segments.src: Its answer was unanimous: election officials hold them, even during a criminal investigation, and the attorney general can order a sheriff to stand down.
segments.tr: その答えは全会一致でした：刑事捜査中であっても選挙管理官がそれらを保持し、司法長官は保安官に手を引くよう命じることができます。

segments.src: For voters, the practical takeaway is that the ballots from that election go back to the officials who are responsible for counting them.
segments.tr: 有権者にとっての実用的な要点は、その選挙の投票用紙が、それらを集計する責任を持つ役人たちのもとに戻るということです。

de.title: 650.000 Stimmzettel, eine einstimmige Entscheidung: Kaliforniens oberstes Gericht weist Sheriff an, beschlagnahmte Stimmen zurückzugeben

segments.src: California's highest court has settled one of the most unusual election disputes in recent state history.
segments.tr: Kaliforniens höchstes Gericht hat einen der ungewöhnlichsten Wahlstreitigkeiten in der jüngeren Geschichte des Staates beigelegt.

segments.src: In a pair of unanimous rulings issued Thursday, the California Supreme Court held that Riverside County Sheriff Chad Bianco unlawfully seized roughly 650,000 ballots from the November 2025 redistricting special election.
segments.tr: In zwei am Donnerstag veröffentlichten einstimmigen Urteilen entschied der Oberste Gerichtshof von Kalifornien, dass Sheriff Chad Bianco aus dem Riverside County etwa 650.000 Stimmzettel der außerordentlichen Wahl zur Neugestaltung der Wahlkreise vom November 2025 unrechtmäßig beschlagnahmt hat.

segments.src: The justices ordered him to return them to county election officials.
segments.tr: Die Richter ordneten an, diese an die Wahlbeamten des Countys zurückzugeben.

segments.src: The decision comes about six weeks before the November midterms.
segments.tr: Die Entscheidung erfolgt etwa sechs Wochen vor den Zwischenwahlen im November.

segments.src: It answers a question that reaches well beyond one county: **when a criminal investigation touches an election, who is allowed to hold the ballots?**
segments.tr: Sie beantwortet eine Frage, die weit über ein einzelnes County hinausreicht: **Wenn eine strafrechtliche Ermittlung eine Wahl berührt, wer darf die Stimmzettel aufbewahren?**

segments.src: ## What the Court Decided
segments.tr: ## Was das Gericht entschied

segments.src: The court issued two rulings on the same day, and both went against the sheriff.
segments.tr: Das Gericht fällte am selben Tag zwei Urteile, die beide gegen den Sheriff ausfielen.

segments.src: - **The seizure was unlawful.** Under California law, voted ballots must stay in the custody and control of election officials. The court found that this rule holds even when law enforcement says it is conducting a criminal investigation. Reports on the opinion say the justices concluded that the seizure created a substantial risk to election integrity.
segments.tr: - **Die Beschlagnahme war unrechtmäßig.** Nach kalifornischem Recht müssen abgegebene Stimmzettel in der Verwahrung und unter der Kontrolle von Wahlbeamten bleiben. Das Gericht stellte fest, dass diese Regel auch dann gilt, wenn die Strafverfolgungsbehörden angeben, eine strafrechtliche Ermittlung durchzuführen. Berichten zufolge kamen die Richter zu dem Schluss, dass die Beschlagnahme ein erhebliches Risiko für die Integrität der Wahl darstellte.

segments.src: - **The attorney general could give the order.** In the companion case, the court held that Attorney General Rob Bonta had the authority to direct the sheriff to hold off on executing a search warrant for the ballots, and that the sheriff was required to comply. Coverage of the ruling attributes the opinion to Chief Justice Patricia Guerrero.
segments.tr: - **Der Generalstaatsanwalt konnte die Anweisung erteilen.** Im Parallelverfahren entschied das Gericht, dass Generalstaatsanwalt Rob Bonta die Befugnis hatte, den Sheriff anzuweisen, von der Vollstreckung eines Durchsuchungsbefehls für die Stimmzettel abzusehen, und dass der Sheriff verpflichtet war, dem nachzukommen. Berichterstattung über das Urteil schreibt die Stellungnahme der Vorsitzenden Richterin Patricia Guerrero zu.

segments.src: Bianco was ordered to return the ballots to the Riverside County registrar of voters.
segments.tr: Bianco wurde angewiesen, die Stimmzettel an den Wahlleiter des Riverside County zurückzugeben.

segments.src: Until then, he is to refrain from handling them except as needed to carry out the order.
segments.tr: Bis dahin soll er es unterlassen, sie zu handhaben, außer wenn es zur Durchführung der Anordnung erforderlich ist.

segments.tr: Lokalen Berichten zufolge werden die Urteile nach 30 Tagen rechtskräftig.

segments.src: ## How the Dispute Unfolded
segments.tr: ## Wie sich der Streit entwickelte

segments.src: The ballots at the center of the case come from the special election on Proposition 50, the measure to redraw California's congressional districts.
segments.tr: Die Stimmzettel im Zentrum des Falls stammen aus der Sonderwahl zu Proposition 50, der Maßnahme zur Neugestaltung der Kongresswahlbezirke Kaliforniens.

segments.src: It passed statewide and also carried Riverside County by roughly 80,000 votes.
segments.tr: Sie wurde landesweit angenommen und gewann im Riverside County mit rund 80.000 Stimmen Vorsprung.

segments.src: - **February 2026:** A local citizens group alleged a discrepancy in the vote count. County election officials described the complaint as unfounded.
segments.tr: - **Februar 2026:** Eine lokale Bürgergruppe behauptete eine Diskrepanz bei der Auszählung der Stimmen. Die Wahlbeamten des Countys bezeichneten die Beschwerde als unbegründet.

segments.src: - **Late February 2026:** Bianco's deputies seized the ballots under a search warrant. A recount began under the supervision of a court-appointed special master, and it was suspended within days as legal challenges piled up.
segments.tr: - **Ende Februar 2026:** Biancos Stellvertreter beschlagnahmten die Stimmzettel im Rahmen eines Durchsuchungsbefehls. Unter der Aufsicht eines vom Gericht ernannten Sonderbeauftragten begann eine Neuauszählung, die jedoch angesichts sich häufender juristischer Schritte innerhalb weniger Tage ausgesetzt wurde.

segments.src: - **March 2026:** The attorney general directed the sheriff to stand down. Bianco did not initially comply, and the dispute moved into the courts.
segments.tr: - **März 2026:** Der Generalstaatsanwalt wies den Sheriff an, sich zurückzuhalten. Bianco kam dem zunächst nicht nach, und der Streit landete vor Gericht.

segments.src: - **April 2026:** The California Supreme Court stepped in and ordered the review of the seized ballots stopped while it considered the case.
segments.tr: - **April 2026:** Der Oberste Gerichtshof von Kalifornien schaltete sich ein und ordnete an, die Überprüfung der beschlagnahmten Stimmzettel zu stoppen, während er den Fall prüfte.

segments.src: - **August 2026:** The justices heard oral arguments.
segments.tr: - **August 2026:** Die Richter hörten die mündlichen Verhandlungen an.

segments.src: - **September 2026:** The court issued its unanimous rulings.
segments.tr: - **September 2026:** Das Gericht fällte seine einstimmigen Urteile.

segments.src: ## The Sheriff's Position
segments.tr: ## Die Position des Sheriffs

segments.src: Bianco's side argued that the sheriff had a legal duty to investigate a complaint that had been brought to him and that the ballots were evidence.
segments.tr: Biancos Seite argumentierte, der Sheriff habe die rechtliche Pflicht, einer an ihn herangetragenen Beschwerde nachzugehen, und die Stimmzettel seien Beweismittel.

segments.src: His attorney made that case to the court.
segments.tr: Sein Anwalt trug diesen Fall dem Gericht vor.

segments.src: Bianco did not immediately comment after the ruling was released.
segments.tr: Bianco äußerte sich nach der Veröffentlichung des Urteils nicht sofort.

segments.src: Bianco also ran in California's June 2026 gubernatorial primary but did not advance to the general election, according to NBC News.
segments.tr: Bianco kandidierte laut NBC News auch in Kaliforniens Vorwahlen für das Amt des Gouverneurs im Juni 2026, zog jedoch nicht in die Hauptwahl ein.

segments.src: He has said he plans to seek re-election as sheriff in 2028.
segments.tr: Er hat erklärt, dass er plant, 2028 erneut als Sheriff zu kandidieren.

segments.src: ## Why Custody Matters
segments.tr: ## Warum die Verwahrung wichtig ist

segments.src: Election law treats the chain of custody for ballots much like a court treats physical evidence: the fewer hands involved, and the more clearly documented each transfer, the more confidence the public can have in the count.
segments.tr: Das Wahlrecht behandelt die Kette der Verwahrung von Stimmzettel ähnlich wie ein Gericht physische Beweismittel: Je weniger beteiligte Hände und je klarer jeder Transfer dokumentiert ist, desto mehr Vertrauen kann die Öffentlichkeit in das Auszählungsergebnis haben.

segments.src: California places that responsibility with county election officials, who work under public observation rules and state oversight.
segments.tr: Kalifornien überträgt diese Verantwortung den Wahlbeamten des Countys, die unter den Regeln öffentlicher Beobachtung und staatlicher Aufsicht arbeiten.

segments.src: The court's reasoning reflects a concern that separate custody rules for law enforcement could undercut that system.
segments.tr: Die Argumentation des Gerichtshofs spiegelt die Sorge wider, dass separate Verwahrungsregeln für Strafverfolgungsbehörden dieses System untergraben könnten.

segments.src: If a ballot can leave the registrar's control at any time for an outside investigation, it becomes harder to show that no one altered it.
segments.tr: Wenn ein Stimmzettel für externe Ermittlungen jederzeit die Kontrolle des Wahlleiters verlassen kann, wird es schwieriger zu beweisen, dass niemand ihn manipuliert hat.

segments.src: That is a problem whether or not any wrongdoing occurred.
segments.tr: Das ist ein Problem, unabhängig davon, ob ein Fehlverhalten stattgefunden hat oder nicht.

segments.src: The ruling does not say that election-related crimes cannot be investigated.
segments.tr: Das Urteil besagt nicht, dass wahlbezogene Straftaten nicht untersucht werden können.

segments.src: It says that voted ballots stay with election officials while that happens.
segments.tr: Es besagt, dass abgegebene Stimmzettel bei den Wahlbeamten verbleiben, während dies geschieht.

segments.src: ## The Legislative Follow-Up
segments.tr: ## Die gesetzlichen Nachbereitungen

segments.src: The ruling arrived days after Gov.
segments.tr: Das Urteil erging Tage, nachdem Gouverneur

segments.src: Gavin Newsom signed a package of 13 election bills on September 19.
segments.tr: Gavin Newsom am 19. September ein Paket von 13 Wahlgesetzen unterzeichnet hatte.

segments.src: According to reporting on the package, it includes measures that:
segments.tr: Berichten zufolge umfasst es Maßnahmen, die:

segments.src: - make it a felony to seize, or to direct or assist in seizing, ballots, election records or certified voting equipment before results are certified (Assembly Bill 282);
segments.tr: - es zu einem Verbrechen machen, Stimmzettel, Wahlunterlagen oder zertifizierte Wahlgeräte vor der Beglaubigung der Ergebnisse zu beschlagnahmen oder die Beschlagnahme anzuordnen beziehungsweise dabei zu helfen (Assembly Bill 282);

segments.src: - make it a felony for a person with supervisory authority to direct someone to interfere with the delivery or return of a vote-by-mail ballot (Senate Bill 259); and
segments.tr: - es für eine Person mit Vorgesetztenfunktion zu einem Verbrechen machen, jemanden anzuweisen, die Lieferung oder Rücksendung eines Briefwahlzettels zu behindern (Senate Bill 259); und

segments.src: - require election officials to notify the attorney general and secretary of state right away about any warrant, subpoena or law enforcement investigation involving election records or voting equipment (Assembly Bill 1664).
segments.tr: - verlangen, dass Wahlbeamte den Generalstaatsanwalt und den Secretary of State unverzüglich über jeden Haftbefehl, jede Vorladung oder jede strafrechtliche Ermittlung im Zusammenhang mit Wahlunterlagen oder Wahlgeräten informieren (Assembly Bill 1664).

segments.src: Supporters describe the laws as guardrails for the midterms.
segments.tr: Befürworter bezeichnen die Gesetze als Leitplanken für die Zwischenwahlen.

segments.src: Critics of the measures have questioned whether such restrictions might limit legitimate investigations, a debate likely to continue.
segments.tr: Kritiker der Maßnahmen haben infrage gestellt, ob solche Einschränkungen legitime Ermittlungen einschränken könnten, eine Debatte, die voraussichtlich weitergeführt wird.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Was als Nächstes kommt

segments.src: Several questions remain open:
segments.tr: Mehrere Fragen bleiben offen:

segments.src: 1. **The return of the ballots.** Bianco must hand the ballots back to the Riverside County registrar. How that transfer is documented will draw scrutiny.
segments.tr: 1. **Die Rückgabe der Stimmzettel.** Bianco muss die Stimmzettel an den Wahlleiter des Riverside County zurückgeben. Wie diese Übergabe dokumentiert wird, wird genaue Aufmerksamkeit erregen.

segments.src: 2. **The fate of the investigation.** Coverage differs on what happens to the underlying inquiry. One local report says the attorney general will decide whether it continues, so the details may become clearer in the coming weeks.
segments.tr: 2. **Das Schicksal der Ermittlungen.** Berichte gehen auseinander darüber, was mit der zugrunde liegenden Untersuchung geschieht. Ein lokaler Bericht besagt, dass der Generalstaatsanwalt entscheiden wird, ob sie fortgesetzt wird, sodass die Details in den kommenden Wochen klarer werden könnten.

segments.src: 3. **The wider fight over election materials.** With the midterms approaching, this case sits inside a larger national argument over who may access, hold and review election records, and under what safeguards.
segments.tr: 3. **Der breitere Streit über Wahlmaterialien.** Da die Zwischenwahlen näher rücken, ist dieser Fall Teil einer größeren nationalen Auseinandersetzung darüber, wer auf Wahlunterlagen zugreifen, diese halten und überprüfen darf und unter welchen Schutzmaßnahmen.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Das Fazit

segments.src: The California Supreme Court did not have to decide whether the sheriff's fraud concerns were right.
segments.tr: Der Oberste Gerichtshof von Kalifornien musste nicht entscheiden, ob die Bedenken des Sheriffs hinsichtlich Betrugs berechtigt waren.

segments.src: It had to decide who is allowed to hold the ballots.
segments.tr: Er musste entscheiden, wer die Stimmzettel halten darf.

segments.src: Its answer was unanimous: election officials hold them, even during a criminal investigation, and the attorney general can order a sheriff to stand down.
segments.tr: Seine Antwort war einstimmig: Wahlbeamte halten sie, selbst während einer strafrechtlichen Ermittlung, und der Generalstaatsanwalt kann einen Sheriff anweisen, sich zurückzuhalten.

segments.src: For voters, the practical takeaway is that the ballots from that election go back to the officials who are responsible for counting them.
segments.tr: Für die Wähler besteht das praktische Fazit darin, dass die Stimmzettel aus dieser Wahl an die Beamten zurückgehen, die für deren Auszählung verantwortlich sind.
